Auto detailing

Three detailing packages, from a wash, towel dry and vacuum to a full interior clean with spray wax and dressed tires. Book ahead so we can set the time aside for your vehicle.

Before you bring it in

  • Take out personal items, or lock them in the glove box.
  • Clear out garbage from the cabin and trunk. If garbage is left, a $20 to $40 removal fee applies.
  • We can refuse vehicles with mold, vermin, broken glass, sharp objects or similar hazards, for the safety of our staff.

Full details are on the disclaimers page.
